notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-address-cwa (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): ADDRESS CWA, the region's common work area (SIT WRKAREA, register X59). The crucible's two-task scenario (S then R) is two single-step scenarios here: the harness does not carry the CWA across scenarios, so R reads a fresh area. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: cwa-link
scenarios.why: WRKAREA 32: the caller stamps the CWA, the LINKed callee (no COMMAREA) reads the stamp and writes its reply through its own ADDRESS CWA

scenarios.name: cwa-store
scenarios.why: ADDRESS CWA, write a stamp through a view

scenarios.name: cwa-read
scenarios.why: ADDRESS CWA read in a task of its own: the area is the region's 32 bytes, fresh here

scenarios.name: unknown-mode
scenarios.why: A mode letter no WHEN names: the EVALUATE falls through
